campaign_name: Theme 4 Stage 10D Transfer and Robustness Campaign

medium.description: Medium explicit cost charging using existing live cost hooks.

description: Live simulator-backed transfer and robustness check across new seeds and deterministic scenario variants. No new cognition or ecology mechanics are introduced.

horizon.note: Matches Stage 10B-3/10C horizon for transfer comparability.

interpretation_limits: Transfer is tested across a compact variant set only.
CUDA is used when available through SimConfig device/bank_device overrides.

scenario_cells.skip_reason: Developmental cognition did not receive a Stage 10C charged-cost sweep and remains lower priority for this bounded transfer campaign.
Stage 5 introspection is extraction-surface-only and not wired into live policy input.
Stage 6 self-regulation is scripted/test surface only and not wired into live policy output.
Stage 7 self-modification is scripted/test surface only and not applied in the live simulation loop.
Stage 8 directed inheritance is scaffold-only and not live-selected through reproduction behavior.

development.reason: Skipped for bounded transfer because Stage 10C did not sweep development costs.

memory.reason: Stage 10C marked memory as a weak cost-robust candidate with pressure mean above flat mean; carry into Patch/Jungle transfer variants plus flat control.

perception.reason: Stage 10C marked perception suspicious because flat-world behavior was stronger than pressure aggregate, but pressure deltas existed; keep a limited transfer check.

prediction.reason: Stage 10C marked prediction as weak cost-robust but pressure aggregate was negative; test flat plus two Patch variants before any longer carry-forward.

sensor_radius.reason: Stage 10C marked sensor radius as a weak cost-robust candidate; test two Patch variants where radius should matter most.

validation_warnings: Perception was carried despite a suspicious Stage 10C flat-world classification, so Stage 10D should treat it as a limited transfer check.
Medium cost is used for all live cells; this is not a cost sweep.
